build_geometry_module: build a GeometryModule to rasterize mesh UV coordinates and compute vertex index and barycentric maps
create_uv_face_index: create a UV-space face index map identifying which mesh face contains each texel using rasterize_meshes
compute_barycentric_coords: compute barycentric coordinates for 2D query points within enclosing triangles for UV interpolation
project_3d_points: project a set of 3D points into multiple cameras using pinhole model with extrinsics and intrinsics
convert_depth_to_normals: convert a depth image to a normal image using camera intrinsics and XYZ gradient computation
